blocks.html: Post-fire smoke purge systems in Group R-2 occupancies shall comply with either Section 917.3.1 or 917.3.2. Smoke removed must be discharged to a safe location outside the building and shall not be recirculated into the building in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code.
